subject: Request: Security-gated VPC sandbox subsidy and trial extension
messages:
From: Dana Lee <dana.lee@aureliabio.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, procurement@aureliabio.com
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Delay in VPC pilot — request for sandbox subsidy & time extension

Hi Jonas,

Quick summary: our security/compliance review uncovered additional network segmentation and vendor-attestation work that will push our VPC pilot start by 4-6 weeks. The commercial team is willing to proceed once we have a private sandbox and a bit more runway to complete the review.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood extend our trial window by 45 days?
- Is there any way to get a temporary credits subsidy tied to this security gating so we can run the full integration tests in an isolated VPC?

I've attached a network diagram and the SOC2 scope questions our auditors sent. Procurement is on copy. We can share more details (scanner output, firewall rules) but wanted to start with a clear ask so we can keep momentum.

Appreciate any flexibility here — this is a high-priority evaluation for us (clinical operations platform).

Thanks,
Dana Lee
Head of IT, Aurelia Bio
[attachment: vpc_network_diagram.png (png, 78KB)]
[attachment: SOC2_Scope_Request.pdf (pdf, 210KB)]

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Dana Lee <dana.lee@aureliabio.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Delay in VPC pilot — request for sandbox subsidy & time extension

Dana — thanks for the heads up and the attachments. Sorry to hear the compliance timeline slipped. Short answers: yes on the extension (provisionally) and possibly yes on a security-linked subsidy, subject to some quick checks.

What I need from you to move this internally this week:
- Confirm exact isolation requirements (NAT/egress restrictions, allowed IP ranges) — one paragraph will do.
- Let us know the minimum token/compute estimate for the sandbox tests (so we can size credits).
- Confirm procurement contact and PO cadence (or confirm if DocuSign is preferred).

I'll loop Ben for commercial approval and Marissa for onboarding/success. If you can provide the above by EOD Thu we should be able to return a formal credit commitment and an updated trial end-date within 48 hours.

Provisional next steps from our side:
- We can grant a 45-day extension now (no paperwork).
- Commercial will evaluate a one-time subsidy up to $15k of hosted credits for the VPC sandbox; anything above that needs leadership sign-off.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
[internal note: provisional credit ceiling communicated to buyer; loop commercial for exact approval]

From: ben.carter@redwood.com <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-03T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Delay in VPC pilot — request for sandbox subsidy & time extension

Jonas / Marissa —

I reviewed Dana's attachments and drafted a short MOU outlining the proposed subsidy and gating conditions. Key points:
- One-time credit subsidy: $15,000 to be applied to the Aurelia Bio VPC sandbox account.
- Extension: 45 days added to current trial.
- Conditions: Redwood requires confirmation of network isolation, an NDA/PO or signed MOU, and proof that Aurelia has engaged their external auditor for SOC2 scoping (or written timeline).

I've attached the MOU (draft) — small redlines expected from procurement/legal. If Legal or Finance need additional guardrails we should surface them before we send to the customer.

If Laura can sign off from a commercial-contract perspective, I'm comfortable escalating for the $15k subsidy. Otherwise we cap at $7,500 and offer technical resources to speed testing.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
[attachment: MOU-Proposed-Subsidy.docx (docx, 96KB)]

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-05T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: MOU - redlines + security checks needed

Forwarding for security sign-off and a quick legal read.

On Thu, Aug 3, 2026 at 08:42, ben.carter@redwood.com wrote:
> Jonas / Marissa —
> 
> I reviewed Dana's attachments and drafted a short MOU outlining the proposed subsidy and gating conditions...
> 
> [attachment: MOU-Proposed-Subsidy.docx]

Ben — see my inline notes on the MOU (we need a clause limiting the subsidy to test traffic only and an SLA escape if the sandbox is used for production traffic). Also want confirmation that any shared logs do not contain PHI; if Aurelia is doing clinical work, we need stronger attestation.

Rishi — can you confirm what minimal evidence you need to clear the subsidy? If it's just a letter from their auditor confirming SOC2 scoping + the network diagram we may be OK; if you need an on-site tech assessment that's a blocker.

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal Ops — Redwood Inference

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-06T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MOU - redlines + security checks needed

Laura / team — quick reply with conditions for the subsidy (approved at security level):

We can approve the one-time $15,000 credit subsidy for Aurelia's VPC sandbox provided the following are delivered before credits are enabled:
1) Signed MOU or PO that references the subsidy and test-only usage.
2) Network isolation confirmation: one-paragraph summary of egress controls + the attached vpc_network_diagram.png.
3) Evidence of SOC2 scoping engagement (email from their auditor or statement of engagement timeline).
4) Confirmation that no PHI will be sent to Redwood endpoints during the trial OR a signed DPA that clarifies responsibility and logging scope.

If the customer supplies items 1-3 we will flip the subsidy flag and apply credits with the 45-day extension that Jonas provisioned; item 4 is mandatory if clinical data is in scope. If they cannot provide all items we can fallback to a smaller subsidy ($7,500) and offer a short security consult to accelerate readiness.

I'll draft a one-paragraph attestation template they can use to satisfy item 3 if needed.

Rishi Malhotra
Security & Compliance Lead — Redwood Inference
[internal note: set conditional flag in deal record; update HubSpot linked deal after MOU signed]
